subject: HealthSync go-live readiness: confirm host roles, links & prework
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lewis <emma@healthsync.co>, HealthSync Onboarding <onboarding@healthsync.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HealthSync go-live readiness: confirm host roles, links & prework

Hi Emma / HealthSync team,

Thanks again for the green light to start the production rollout. Before we lock a kickoff, two quick asks so the session is smooth on Day 1:

1) Please pick your preferred 90-minute window via the poll below (we'll reserve the calendar once you confirm): https://doodle.com/poll/healthsync-launch-availability

2) Can you confirm attendee list + primary technical contact? Right now we expect: Emma Lewis (PM), onboarding@healthsync.co, and one SRE (required for routing tests). If someone else should be invited, reply here.

Draft agenda (we can trim to 60 min if needed):
- 0-10 min: Intros + success criteria
- 10-30 min: Deployment plan & network checklist (SRE attends)
- 30-60 min: Integration verification (end-to-end test)
- 60-80 min: Observability & rollback plan
- 80-90 min: Next steps / action items

Prework: please complete the attached HS-Prework-Checklist.pdf (network IPS, service accounts, consent for recording).

Internal owners (for your awareness): Marissa Cole (Onboarding Lead) will run the session; Priyom Das will own the integration verification; Vivek Kulkarni is backup for bridge ops.

I'll hold a tentative invite after you pick a poll slot, then share the Zoom bridge + recording settings.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0110

Attachment: HS-Prework-Checklist.pdf (1 page)
From: Emma Lewis <emma@healthsync.co>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: HealthSync Onboarding <onboarding@healthsync.co>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HealthSync go-live readiness: confirm host roles, links & prework

Hi Monica — thanks, this looks good.

I filled out the poll (Friday 6/23, 10:00–11:30 PT works best for us). Our SRE will be Aaron Park (aaron.park@healthsync.co) — please add him to the invite. We'll also include our Compliance lead, Nina Ortega (nina.ortega@healthsync.co), so she can confirm data retention settings during the observability section.

We can complete the prework by Thursday end of day. We are OK with recording the session as long as the recording is used only for internal troubleshooting.

See you Friday — feel free to send the calendar and bridge when ready.

Best,
Emma
Emma Lewis
Product Manager, HealthSync

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lewis <emma@healthsync.co>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HealthSync go-live readiness: confirm host roles, links & prework

Thanks Emma — Friday 2028-06-23 10:00 PT is confirmed from our side. I've created the calendar invite and added Aaron & Nina (onboarding@healthsync.co: please confirm attendee addresses if I missed anyone).

Bridge + meeting artifacts:
- Zoom bridge: https://zoom.us/j/999888777?pwd=bridge  (passcode on calendar)
- Recording policy: recording enabled for Redwood hosts; recording will be added to the HealthSync Drive folder and deleted after 30 days unless you ask us to keep it longer.
- Miro board for verification exercises: https://miro.com/app/board/uXjV-healthsync-kickoff

Host/backup roles (for the agenda above):
- Primary host & runbook: Marissa Cole (I will lead the session and timebox agenda items).
- Integration lead (test owner): Priyom Das (will run end-to-end verification steps).
- Bridge operator / recording owner: Vivek Kulkarni (manages breakout links, recording start/stop).

I've attached a small CSV with the launch roles and invite roster (redwood-launch-roles.csv) and a short text file with bridge fallback details (bridge-details.txt).

Action items before Friday:
- HealthSync: complete HS-Prework-Checklist.pdf by Thursday COB.
- Redwood (Priyom): prepare the verification checklist and share two test prompts.
- Marissa: send final agenda and calendar invite (on my way now).

On Fri I'll open the meeting 10 minutes early to validate recording & screen share.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-launch-roles.csv (1), bridge-details.txt (1)

Subject: Re: HealthSync go-live readiness: confirm host roles, links & prework

Perfect — thank you all for the quick turn. A couple final notes before Friday:

- Aaron / Nina: please confirm Aaron's calendar invite and Nina's attendance when you have a moment (we need at least one SRE + one compliance contact).
- Priyom: can you post the two test prompts to the Drive folder by Thursday EOD so HealthSync can review? Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-launch-prework
- Recording consent: Emma, thanks for confirming. We'll limit distribution to the HealthSync Drive folder and Redwood project folder only.

If there's nothing else, Marissa will send the final invite with the bridge passcode and short runbook. Looking forward to a smooth session.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
